content.short: Cardano Pixies is a Cardano GameFi NFT project with AI-generated Pixies, collectible characters, and play-to-earn plans.
content.description: Cardano Pixies is a Cardano GameFi NFT project built around AI-generated Pixie characters. Each Pixie is represented as a unique NFT with its own visual traits, while the project has described plans for play-to-earn utility and broader game features. The collection connects Cardano-native ownership with character art and early GameFi ideas, giving holders a way to collect, trade, and participate in a themed NFT ecosystem. Its appeal is a mix of generative art, fantasy branding, and planned gameplay.
